short_description: Deliciously cheffy spins on salads and bowls

items.name: Build-Your-Own
items.description: Select your favorite toppings, cheese, protein, crunchy add-ons and dressing. Whatever combo you choose, it will be perfectly complemented by your favorite greens and grains

items.name: Spicy Salmon Sashimi Salad
items.description: Diced raw salmon* and spicy mayo combined with avocado, edamame, Persian cucumber, cilantro, and pickled red onion. Served over romaine and spring mix and topped with crispy rice pearls. Suggested Pairing: Roasted Sesame Dressing

items.name: Royal Roots Bowl
items.description: Roasted broccoli, sweet potato, carrots, and crispy quinoa served over grains and kale. Suggested pairing: Whole Grain Mustard Vinaigrette

items.name: Esther Choi's Gochujang Honey Chicken Salad
items.description: Chef Esther Choi's signature gochujang honey chicken shines in this vibrant salad, complemented by a bright blend of veggies, fried shallots, and tangy kimchi. Suggested Pairing: Gochujang Dressing.

items.name: Esther Choi's Seoul Bowl
items.description: Your ticket to Seoul, in a bowl. A vibrant mix of veggies, crispy rice pearls, kimchi, and Chef Esther Choi's signature gochujang honey chicken on a bed of grains. Suggested Pairing: Gochujang Dressing.

items.name: Esther Choi's Seoul-ba Noodle Bowl with Tuna
items.description: Chef Esther Choi puts a refreshing, Korean-inspired spin on a soba noodle salad with sushi-grade tuna, crunchy veggies, tart Granny Smith apples, avocado, fried shallots, and kimchi. Suggested Pairing: Gochujang Dressing.

items.name: Bobby Flay's Citrus & Blue Cheese Salad
items.description: Chef Bobby Flay combines chopped kale and romaine lettuce with sweet mandarin orange segments, candied pecans, and blue cheese crumbles. Chef's recommended pairing: Lime Chipotle Vinaigrette

items.name: Marc Murphy’s Crispy Leaf & Feta Salad
items.description: You'll love the play between Crispy Leaf lettuce and tangy feta, accented with bright scallions and fresh dill in Chef Marc Murphy's simple but delicious salad. Chef's recommended pairing: Lemon Vinaigrette

items.name: Maydan’s Fattoush Salad
items.description: Maydan makes the zestiest salad this side of Tripoli: romaine lettuce, cucumbers, tomatoes, mint, pickled red onion, chickpeas, radish, and pita chip crumbles. Chef's recommended pairing: Pomegranate Vinaigrette

items.name: Blue Cheese & Pecan Salad
items.description: Blue cheese crumbles make a salty contrast to sweet candied pecans, dried cherries, and pickled red onions, topped with a sprinkle of crispy quinoa and served on romaine and kale. Suggested Pairing: Lemon Vinaigrette

items.name: Beet & Goat Cheese Salad
items.description: Crispy Leaf and spring mix are topped with roasted beets, goat cheese crumbles, herbed slivered almonds, scallions, and mint, then sprinkled with crispy quinoa. Suggested Pairing: Pomegranate Vinaigrette

items.name: Mandarin Crunch Salad
items.description: In this globe-hopping salad, Crispy Leaf and spring mix are layered with cabbage, carrots, cucumbers, edamame, mandarin orange, crispy shallots, and cilantro. Suggested pairing: Royal Miso Dressing

items.name: Thai Peanut Salad
items.description: An irresistibly crunchy mix of cabbage, carrots, tomatoes, cucumbers, cilantro, mint, roasted peanuts, and crispy fried shallots. Suggested pairing: Peanut Dressing

items.name: Cobb Salad
items.description: A fresh take on a classic Cobb: romaine and kale topped with avocado, hard boiled egg, bacon lardons, and tomato, plus cheddar, cucumber, roasted corn, and crispy quinoa. Suggested Pairing: Green Goddess Dressing

items.name: Greek Salad
items.description: A standout salad made with tomatoes, cucumber, Kalamata olives, pickled red onions, chickpeas, feta, and pita chip crumbles on a bed of romaine lettuce. Suggested Pairing: Oregano Vinaigrette

items.name: Royal Caesar Salad
items.description: The classic Caesar gets a mini makeover with tomatoes, garlic croutons, and grated Parmesan on a bed of romaine and kale. Suggested Pairing: Caesar Dressing

items.name: Buffalo Salad
items.description: Inspired by our favorite wings, this salad is made with pickled red onion, carrots, cucumber, cheddar, garlic croutons, and Buffalo sauce on romaine and kale. Suggested Pairing: Blue Cheese Dressing

items.name: Crispy Rice Bowl
items.description: New for the season: a vibrant, texture-packed bowl with chopped cucumber, shredded carrots, red cabbage, cilantro, slivered almonds, and crispy rice pearls. Served on a bed of grains and spring mix. Suggested Pairing: Roasted Sesame Dressing.

items.name: Harvest Bowl
items.description: Sweet, earthy, and crispy-crunchy: grains and kale are topped with roasted sweet potato, goat cheese crumbles, candied pecans, and dried cherries. Suggested pairing: Balsamic Vinaigrette

items.name: Pesto Parm Bowl
items.description: A hearty combination of grated Parmesan, roasted broccoli, diced sweet potato, chickpeas, tomatoes, crispy quinoa, and a sprinkle of Italian breadcrumbs. Served over grains and romaine. Suggested pairing: Basil Pesto and lemon wedge

items.name: Miso Avocado Bowl
items.description: Edamame, avocado, cucumbers, carrots, radishes, and pickled red onions are layered with furikake seasoning and served over grains and spring mix. Suggested pairing: Royal Miso Dressing

items.name: Kids Chicken Tenders
items.description: When in doubt, get the chicken tenders. 2 crispy strips of chicken, breaded and fried until golden brown. Served with honey mustard sauce or ketchup for dipping

items.name: Kids Mac & Cheese
items.description: Mac and cheese, please! Curly pasta smothered in lots of creamy, dreamy white cheddar sauce

items.name: Chocolate Pecan Pie by Four & Twenty Blackbirds
items.description: Lightly toasted, buttery pecans, blended with a classic (but not too sweet) pecan pie style custard, atop a decadent layer of dark chocolate ganache. A perfect slice from a bakery started by two sisters, where tradition meets Brooklyn charm

items.name: Pumpkin Spice Pudding by Magnolia Bakery
items.description: Aromatic pumpkin spice, crunchy gingersnap cookies, and creamy banana pudding create the perfect fall treat. Available for a limited time only.

items.name: Sea Salt Chocolate Chip Cookie by Hungry Gnome
items.description: Perfectly chewy on the inside, crisp on the edges, and the perfect balance of salty and sweet, this cookie is packed with high-quality Semi-Sweet Chocolate and topped with Maldon Flake Sea Salt. 6 oz

items.name: Dark & White Chocolate Toffee Cookie by Hungry Gnome
items.description: A large, thick, and chewy cookie that's packed with dark & white chocolate chunks, milk chocolate chips, and salted English toffee bits. 6 oz

items.name: Cookie Butter Chip Cookie by Hungry Gnome
items.description: Crispy on the edges and chewy in the center, this cookie is studded with vegan dark chocolate chunks and swirled with Biscoff cookie butter. It's also vegan. 3 oz

items.name: Chocolatier Killer Brownie
items.description: A rich chocolate brownie made with premium milk chocolate chips—soft and moist with a thin crackle top

items.name: Brookie Killer Brownie
items.description: Chewy chocolate chip cookie layered with rich, fudgy brownie

items.name: Brown Butter Krisp Bar by Dana's Bakery
items.description: The OG Krisp Bar features a brown butter marshmallow base and the original krisp rice cereal you know and love

items.name: Cookies & Creme Krisp Bar by Dana's Bakery
items.description: From Dana's Bakery, the Cookies & Creme Krisp Bar features regular and cocoa krisp rice cereal and gluten-free Oreos

items.name: Banana Pudding Wafer Cookie Bits by Magnolia Bakery
items.description: Indulge in Magnolia Bakery's banana pudding, a delightful naturally flavored treat whipped to perfection with wafer cookie bits. This creamy dessert captures the classic flavors of banana pudding and is made with real bananas and no artificial flavors. Experience the perfect blend of creamy banana pudding and crunchy wafer cookie bits in every bite

items.name: Cookies & Cream Vanilla Pudding by Magnolia Bakery
items.description: A cookies & cream lover's dream, only available on Wonder. Fluffy vanilla pudding whipped with chocolate cookie crumbles and rich fudge swirl for an indulgently sweet treat.

items.name: Cupcake Duo by Magnolia Bakery
items.description: The cupcakes that made Magnolia Bakery famous. One chocolate cupcake topped with chocolate buttercream and sprinkles and one vanilla cupcake topped with pink vanilla buttercream and a daisy

items.name: Baked by Melissa's Bite-Size Cupcakes
items.description: Six bite-size cupcakes in Baked by Melissa's most-loved signature flavors: Tie-Dye, Cookie & Cream, Triple Chocolate Fudge, Red Velvet, Cookie Dough, and Chocolate Chip Pancake. All iced by hand
